fusions.name: Funnel Report
fusions.desc: Fires a pressurised jet from your funnel that deals 40 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Rapid Salvo
fusions.desc: Looses 3 spurts of ink in quick succession, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Recoil Jet
fusions.desc: A jet from your funnel that carries you 4 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Hot Chamber
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
